newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint eases vs dlr, Swiss franc tops futures trade.
newsitem.headline: Forint eases vs dlr, Swiss franc tops futures trade.

text.p: The Hungarian forint ended the Friday session of the interbank forex market weaker against the dollar after range trading, dealers said.
"The forint followed the dollar movements throughout the session," said Robert Szucs of Creditanstalt.The forint finished at 166.20/26 against the dollar against an opening of 165.92/166.00.
The Hungarian unit was some 10 pips weaker than the central bank's bid but dealers expected it to close or at least narrow the gap on Monday.
Currency futures turnover on the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) rose to a substantial 3.13 billion forints from Thursday's 739 million.
Swiss franc futures stole the show once more, accounting for three quarters of the total 20,497 contracts turnover.
The German mark remained mostly steady, dollar and sterling futures rose for all maturities and the Janapese yen weakened for all but the February maturity.
